ActivityPub HTTP server built on powpow.

Serves actor profiles, WebFinger, inbox, outbox, followers, and following endpoints. Uses InboxDispatcher for receiving activities and ActivityStore for data persistence.

Usage: let store = newActivityStore() discard store.registerActor("alice", "example.com", "Alice") var server = newActivityPubServer("example.com", store) server.registerFollow server.start(Port(9000))
